Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

title: AI Clicker Demo

Demo Features 2 Full Replayable Maps, 3 Starting Decks & tons more.

description: Life is brief... But death? That's another story. Celestial is a competitive card game where experience is worth its weight in gold. Weave your tale with beautifully illustrated cards. Uncover powerful synergies to claim victory. Follow the paths of the Penumbra, or match wits against other players.

title: Crafty Idle Demo
description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

title: Message From Aliens Demo
description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

title: Woke Quest Demo
description: Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality.

title: PLATFORM 13 Demo

title: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator Demo
description: Run your own ice cream shop in the Livin' the Cream demo! Serve customers, make Soft Serve and Scoop Ice Cream in three flavors, serve with different types of cones, and customize your shop with different floors, walls, counters, and tables.

title: Boundary Cage Demo
description: A dark dystopian interactive novel. Trapped within a cage ruled by alien races, you will meet different characters and make critical choices. Every decision you make alters the plot, unlocking branching storylines and multiple endings in this suspenseful narrative.

title: Shared RC Demo
description: You drive left. They drive right. Straight? Only if you're both on the same page. Shared RC splits control of one car between two players — team up (or don't) across brutal, physics-based courses where every wrong move is somebody else's fault too.

title: Mask Me Anything Demo
description: Mask Me Anything is a turn-based score-building roguelike about selling omen masks at a mysterious Japanese festival. Arrange masks on a grid, create chain combos, upgrade your deck, and earn enough money to survive five days of rising sales quotas.

description: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

title: Fat Chance Demo
description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, your towers unleash their power against ever-growing zombie hordes.

description: Nebula Sky Crossing is a game that blends 2D side-scrolling shooting—where you pilot a spaceship as a space trader—with station-based trading. Aim to conquer a galaxy filled with dangers such as pirates by mastering piloting skills and upgrades.

description: You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf! After yet another hilarious night terrorizing locals, it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

title: Six is Devil Demo
description: An incremental game about rolling dice until all dice land on 6. Improve your odds, corrupt your dice, and place bets to achieve the perfect roll. Can you get all 6s?

description: Spirit of the Birch is an adventure game with grid-based movement and dungeon crawler elements. Follow the story of a village guy who has lost the spark of his mind. Explore a strange world, fight enemies, solve puzzles, and experience an unusual adventure with a touch of humor.

description: Play as the "Techno King" of a thriving Silicon Valley startup in this active incremental game. description: Shadows of Imalor is a single-player/co-op fantasy adventure RPG where you awaken in a dying land with no memory. description: The first 5,000 meters of Deep Digger. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that keep climbing while you keep going deeper. Dig, sell what you haul up, upgrade, dig further. Prestige, keep your talents, and clear in minutes what took you an hour.

description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

title: Regression Demo
description: In this first-person psychological horror game, visit your ex-girlfriend during a mental breakdown at her childhood home. Uncover the truth behind her crisis by searching for clues, talking to unsettling characters and solving puzzles. Just be ready to run and hide when her nightmares come alive.

title: StowStow Demo
description: StowStow puts you in a physics-driven warehouse where every box has weight and consequence. Scan cargo, dodge explosions, draft upgrade cards, and build conveyor lines until the chaos runs itself.

description: Boku Boku is an unrestrained sandbox game. You can build houses, create your own worlds, and make new friends. Explore a wondrous world, and leave your mark in this pixel paradise.

description: Solve the murder as the High School club Smashville Detective Agency! Mystery is afoot in the normally quiet mountain town of Smashville. It is up to you to find the murderer and save the day!

description: Embark on a rescue mission to save your companion. Explore the underground labyrinth left behind by the ancient humans, recover lost technology, discover Ley magic, fight strange creatures and try not to panic!

description: A physics based incremental game where you throw the little white square dude around.

title: Second Reign: Reclaim Demo
description: Reclaim a fallen kingdom solo or in online co-op in a dark fantasy roguelite tower defense. Deploy forgotten guards, strengthen them with upgrades and cards, survive relentless undead waves and brutal bosses, and grow stronger with every run.

description: Try the free DashBreaker demo. Dodge missile barrages and dash straight through enemy hulls. Combine a piercing dash with survival and power modules, then fight through handcrafted arcade sectors to face the Carrier and the Dreadnought.

title: Gunline Demo
description: YOU ARE THE LAST TURRETThe enemy walks one road. You are standing on that road.Gold drops off the enemies mid-wave, and that same gold builds your turrets. There is no build phase and no combat phase. There is one phase, and not enough time in it.SHOOTSix firearms, pistol to rocket launcher, and a four-step melee ladder.

title: Idle Slots: Casino HQ Demo
description: Build your empire from a single Penny Slot to a floor filled with intergalactic Galaxy Slots. The Idle Slots Demo is 100% fully playable with UNLIMITED playtime. You can prestige, build your empire to the trillions, and experience the entire core gameplay loop forever.

title: Feathered Fortune Demo
description: Run a pigeon post in the medieval kingdom of Melthoria. Raise your pigeons, negotiate delivery contracts, grow your farm, and help rebuild the kingdom with every message you send.

title: CRACK & COLLECT Demo
description: Crack & Collect is an addictive incremental game about cracking open collectible eggs. Discover rare figurines, sell them or put them on display, upgrade your tools, and turn one dollar into a billion!

title: Monster Mavericks Demo
description: Hunt mechanical monstrosities in a steampunk Wild West. Choose your loadout, gather a posse of up to four players, collect powerful upgrades and deploy combat drones as you explore dangerous frontiers and bring down notorious bosses.

title: Idle Digger Bots Deluxe Demo
description: A sci-fi idle and automation game where you manage mining bots to dig deep and sell resources.

title: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm Demo
description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

title: RENSE Demo
description: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight your way through a map of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

title: Crack a Pack Demo
description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

title: Adventurer’s Guild Manager Demo
description: Manage your own adventurer's guild, create custom quest contracts, trade magical items with adventurers, and grow your reputation in a cozy stylized low poly world.

title: The Monkey's Paw Demo
description: Hold the monkey's paw and make a wish, but remember: everything comes at a price. A short horror visual novel where choices matter...painfully. This demo covers the first 15 minutes of the full game.

title: Dice Roll Society Demo
description: The dice crafting roguelite where every roll scores. Build your scoring machine and craft five dice face by face. Beat bosses and steal their dice before your rolls run out.

title: Dynamic Breach Demo
description: Free demo of Dynamic Breach, a top-down tactical shooter of military gothic and necro-technological horror. Play the five operations of the prologue with an AI squad to command, plus Breach against bots. The full campaign continues for 28 more operations across five acts.

title: Loop Loader Demo
description: Loop Loader is a game about loading, upgrading, and unlocking loops and technology! LOOP EVERYTHING!!! Don't stop till you've broken the game!

title: Shuffle and Seek Demo
description: Shuffle and Seek is a 2-4 player party game of memory and mischief! You split into two teams: one secretly rearranges everything in the room, and the other tries to figure out exactly what changed.

title: Ciao Pizza: Cooking Chaos Demo
description: Run a chaotic pizza shop alone or with up to three friends. Make every pizza by hand, deal with impatient customers, keep the kitchen running, and race deliveries across town before everything gets cold, burnt, or completely out of control.

title: Rope Ninja Demo
description: Express your skill.Rope racing lives underground. Crews open portals into factories, dojos, rooftops and places deep beneath the city, turning them into courses. Runners come through to find faster lines, challenge each other and earn the respect of people who understand what a clean run takes.

title: 히루가오(ひるがお) Demo
description: demo. A mystery psychological thriller visual novel set in 2000. Follow a serial murder case through the eyes of three characters: the woman, the man, and the detective. With live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters, every choice branches the story, and one wrong move means game over.

title: Barns & Beams Demo
description: You are a city kid who can no longer afford housing, but luckily, your grandfather has left you his disastrous farm in the middle of nowhere as an inheritance. You will have to learn to manage farm life and, along the way, deal with "Them."

title: Mindbreak Demo
description: Mindbreak is an exploration driven tile-based puzzle adventure game about the escape from a corrupted insane asylum. Play as the supernaturally gifted asylum patients as you build and combine their unique abilities to explore and master the vast interconnected asylum.

title: Post Office: Tidy Up Demo
description: Post Office: Tidy Up is a cozy first-person sorting game. A huge post office is buried under 3,268 parcels. Pick one up, look at it, put it where it belongs. Sort by colour, pattern and shape, learn post magic, and turn the mess into perfectly filled shelves.

title: State Of Fear: The Final Shift Demo
description: State Of Fear: The Final Shift Demo is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience. Step into an atmospheric retro office environment, unravel a slow-burn mystery in the dark, and endure a bite-sized descent into the unknown.

title: Ratmageddon Underground Demo
description: Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

title: Bingo Bingle Demo
description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

title: A Sweet Treat for Nona Demo
description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

title: Dirtnap Demo
description: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.
developer: Unstable Entity, Part Time Monkey, Nitroyale

title: Groove Core Demo
description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

title: Gull's Gang
description: Two teams of birds, one quiet street. Then the game starts: hurl tables, crates, fish, scooters and anything else that falls under your wings onto the enemy side. After 3 minutes, the scale decides: the most cluttered side loses. Couch, split-screen or LAN, up to 4 players.

title: Sewer Crawler Demo
description: Sewer Crawler is a single-player roguelike auto-battler made by a single developer. Crawl through dangerous sewers, assemble an unstoppable army, discover powerful artifacts, and master deep team synergies in tactical auto-battles. Every system, unit, and asset was handcrafted from scratch.

title: Cats Out Demo
description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

title: Heroes of Retribution Demo
description: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

title: linger
description: Lin Xiao returns from school to find her home a cold funeral hall. Family missing. Strange Taoist priest. Obsessive classmate. Mysterious butterflies. She has seven days. Trapped in absurd horror, every choice leads to different endings. Your decisions decide her fate.

title: Mancalero Demo
description: Mancalero is a marble board game fusing roguelike progression with deckbuilder strategy. Collect special marbles, unlock powerful blessings, and defeat every table to become the true Mancalero.

title: ALL EYES ON ME Demo
description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. Thousands of eyes hunt you in this bullet heaven roguelite. Their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

title: Voyage Router Demo
description: The further you go, the more the universe turns against you. Voyage Router is a navigation-driven roguelite strategy game where you explore dimensional oceans, chart optimal paths, and risk everything for a greater haul.

title: A Living Corner Demo
description: A little life for your desktop. Watch mountains shift from day to night, ripple a pond and play with birds and fish. Enjoy 15 themes in a window, as live wallpaper or a screensaver: pressure-free company at your own pace, with six handy tools and media controls.

title: SYNTAX WARS Demo
description: Free demo of SYNTAX WARS. Play 3 of the 6 fighters — NEXUS-7, SHADOW, BLAZE — in VS CPU and local 2-player. Commit your move in secret, flip at the same instant: no reflexes, just reads. The full game adds 3 more fighters, an arcade gauntlet, challenge runs, and the story. Wishlist it!

title: Land of Ruins Demo
description: You receive the elves' call and enter the mist. Evade the Dark Lord, explore, and strengthen your squad. Trap or opportunity? Flee or fight? Craft your strategy, build your unique system, complete quests, conquer levels, and defeat evil lords.

title: Hordes Of War Demo
description: Persistent combat and sieges. Hardcore fantasy RP to run and govern territories. Leveling system. Crafting. Castle and fort sieges. Resource collecting.

title: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS Demo
description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS DemoThe Demo will be available from September 16 to October 31, 2026 (Los Angeles / Pacific Time).Thank you for playing ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS!If you enjoy the game, please consider recommending it to your friends and adding it to your Steam Wishlist.

title: Leaf Us Alone Demo
description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

title: 塑时者 Demo
description: "Derealization" is a visual novel that combines Japanese campus youth, suspenseful loops, and supernatural combat. The main characters in this work are voiced by professional Japanese actors. Inserting original animation clips into the climactic scenes greatly enhances the impact of the plot.

title: Infant God Demo
description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

title: Emissary One Demo
description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

title: Forever RPG Demo
description: Embark on a new adventure on every playthrough. Find equipment, meet all sorts of NPCs and battle your way through a short 10 chapter randomised story. A casual retro roguelite RPG you can play forever!

title: Multiplayer Animals Demo
description: A turn-based PVP strategy game. Eliminate all enemy animals before they eliminate yours. Fire bazookas, launch airstrikes, destroy (and construct) terrain, or knock your enemies off the map entirely with a well-placed swing of a baseball bat.

title: Wuxing Demo
description: Free demo of Wuxing: Elemental Array Poker, a feng-shui roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are placed onto a 3×3 altar and the Five Elements chain between cells. Play the first two seasons, wake the beasts, and take on the Azure Dragon and the Vermilion Bird.

title: Bluy Leaves Home Demo
description: A turn-based bullet-hell JRPG game.

title: Cellular Sorcery Demo
description: Play the demo of Cellular Sorcery, an action roguelite set in a chaotic microscopic universe. Travel across strange cell planets, combine upgrades in wild ways, defeat powerful bosses, and become the most infectious cell in the system alone or with friends.

title: Nine Provinces DEMO
description: "The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

title: Yorick: Worlds in Bloom Demo
description: THE CURRENT DEMOThe Steam demo takes place in The Withered Garden, a small world divided into five distinct regions, each with its own landscape, vegetation, discoveries, and character.It is an early look at the heart of Yorick: Worlds in Bloom: recycle what has died, discover what was forgotten, and find joy in bringing life back to the...

title: Megastore Chaos Demo
description: Megastore Chaos Demo - Turn massive messes into perfect order. Sort 30,452 items across 6 unique stores — from supermarkets and bookstores to electronics, games, wine and toys — while unlocking skills that make organizing faster and more satisfying.

title: Submarine Homesick Blues Demo
description: A real-time submarine management and survival game with tactical pause, where you manage crew, systems, and resources under constant pressure.

title: Aspect Arena Demo
description: A siege auto-battler. Draft an Aspect, buy fighters, arm them, then watch the line decide it without you. One castle for the whole run, a rival who returns each round, and a dragon at the end that cannot be killed, only measured against.

title: 8-bitBot Demo
description: 8-bitBot is a programming puzzle game where you place simple instructions in a program to make your bots transport objects in a factory environment.

title: MAD [Demo]
description: MAD is a hardcore top-down action shooter set in a violent, 90s-inspired dystopia, featuring light RPG progression and inventory management. The story unfolds in a corrupt city of the future, where the elite stage and broadcast a deadly show — and you are the next contestant.

title: Pull My Finger Demo
description: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...
developer: Nothing But Nonsense Studios LLC, Burnt Pineapples

title: Novella Oscura Reverie Demo
description: Novella Oscura is a dark fantasy JRPG set in the ruined kingdom of Albion and the mysterious Dreaming Realms of humanity. Explore a dying world, uncover its darkest secrets, and face enemies in a unique combat system that seamlessly blends real-time action with turn-based strategy.

title: SoleRulerDemo
description: The trial version can't attack and has no skills! Can't grow at all. Please consider.

title: The Way Home Demo
description: Drive safely to your destination in a country where even the tiniest tap with your car can put you on death row.

title: Pearly Gates Demo
description: Congratulations. You have died. The Office of Eternal Placement extends its condolences, and an opportunity. Most souls go on to judgment. Your name was drawn instead: Clerk of Admissions, Pearly Gates. The post carries one duty. Decide who enters Heaven, and who does not.

title: Garden Gingdom Demo
description: Garden Gingdom is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

title: Echoes of Aromia Demo
description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

title: Novo: The Colony Demo
description: Experience the first 5 days of Novo: The Colony with full gameplay, no restrictions, straight from the start of your colony's story.

title: Foundlings Demo
description: Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Level up your Liberal Arts, forge spells by combining conduits and watch the motions of the planets. The demo contains the prologue to Foundlings, exploring young Agnes's relationship with her Master.

title: Imperial Kingdoms Demo
description: Lead a medieval realm in this 4X grand strategy game with pausable real-time. Establish vital infrastructure to supply your capital and sustain your armies. Design custom military templates, manage production estates, and conquer rival kingdoms via strategic sieges and raids.

title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG Demo
description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Play world 1 and up to the first 150 waves of the official game! Meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

title: LITA Protocol Demo
description: Power on an old computer and meet LITA. Together, you will explore how computer memory works through a series of puzzles.

title: Healing For Dummies Demo
description: Keep your party alive while also dealing with all the boss mechanics on your own. Master your build, master bosses, become a better healer. Get blamed when your party dies. In this short little demo you will face 6 bosses and your job is simple - keep everyone alive.

title: Deadzone Cleanup Crew Demo
description: In this incremental game, scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

title: ROSHAMBRAWL Demo
description: Ro Sham Brawl is a rock, paper, scissors fighting game where you brawl your friends in chaotic rounds of fast-paced, physics-based competition. Launch powerful attacks with crazy abilities, while destroying arenas and friendships with every shot.

title: Goodnight, B Demo
description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

title: Granule Demo
description: Murray cannot die. The Granule prefers this. A physics sandbox where everything is simulated, not scripted, and nothing is locked or timed.

title: King's Haven Demo
description: Build your deck, expand your kingdom, and defend your Haven! Recruit Citizens, construct landmarks, and build powerful combos in this roguelike deckbuilder where each card is a Citizen and each season brings new rewards, new threats, and new choices.

title: 여우 퇴마사는 존중받고 싶었다. Demo
description: "When I was at my coldest and loneliest, you didn't drive me away." A emotional, story-driven visual novel about Seoroa and a young fox-exorcist.

title: Mapping Creator Demo
description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

title: Trust The System Demo
description: Trust the System is an intriguing incremental game where you mindlessly stamp papers to explore the System's restricted corridors. Upgrade your tools to better uncover what your job is really about...

title: Century of Conquest Demo
developer: Tang Jie, SHENZHEN JIYE MINGNIAO GAME TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

title: Seen NOT Heard Demo
description: After a horrible nightmare, Melia bolts awake but finds herself unable to scream… Her mouth has been sewn shut! What happened to her? Only the Monsters remember. Face them and explore with Melia the theme of family trauma, through this carefully illustrated RPG.

title: Yokai Mart Demo
description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Take over your grandmother’s konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

title: Forklift Logistics Simulator Demo
description: This demo includes a short tutorial and four increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Learn to handle the forklift as you move cargo and load trucks. Put your precision and balance to the test.

title: Out Of Sync Demo
description: Keil, a junior employee at Vanta Inc., has been searching for his missing friend Marcus. As he finds a note in Marcus's handwriting, Keil steps into a parallel world, only to face an unforgettable reality at the final door.

title: Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator Demo
description: Become a master blacksmith in this fantasy simulator demo! Combine unique parts and materials to forge custom weapons, haggle with customers, and build your dream medieval shop.

title: Cleaner Company Demo
description: Play the free demo of Cleaner Company, a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean up the Flying Canteen, a space restaurant infested by friendly mutant chickens and unfriendly alien pests.

title: Penguin, but why? Demo
description: This demo is about the first step. About the moment when familiar life, identical days, and endless routine begin to feel unbearable. When staying where you are becomes harder than taking a step into the unknown. Leave the colony and begin a journey whose meaning you have yet to understand.

title: Paystreak Demo
description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. The demo gives you the start of that journey. Work your way from pans and shovels to your first mechanized production chain. You get three seasons to prove you can run a gold mining company.

title: Generic Fighter Maybe Demo
description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

title: The Tainted Lands Demo
description: Tainted Lands is a turn-based tactical RPG in an eldritch fantasy setting. Lead a band of adventurers to traverse a forbidden wilderness where ancient horrors lie in wait. Recruit companions, scavenge relics, and face the Outer Gods.

title: Death Elephant: The Manor Demo
description: Death Elephant: The Manor is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious Vietnamese estate. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover dark historical secrets, and evade terrifying supernatural entities to survive. Can you face the dark?

title: Duplexity Demo
description: Two paddles, one ball. Hit the targets and keep the game alive. A simple yet difficult game of coordination, patience and dexterity. Think you can reach 0... or lower?

title: Screen Stocks Demo
description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

title: Hell Wait Demo
description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

title: Graveyard Keeper 2 Demo
description: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse Demo
description: Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

title: Probably Stolen Demo
description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

title: Dark Journey to the West Demo
description: A dark-themed idle loot game. Gather and train minions and artifacts with distinct abilities — then pit your builds against legendary bosses. Lead your monster squad through the Heavenly Palace, the Underworld, the sacred mountains, and beyond, all in search of the true scriptures.

title: Void Nebula Demo
description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

title: Match&Magic Demo
description: Match & Magic is a roguelike match-n adventure. Players defeat enemies and cast skills by matching tiles while climbing randomly generated towers. With cute cartoon visuals, it offers unique runs, loot, upgrades, strategy and high replayability.

title: Eclipse Island Primal Odyssey Demo
description: Survive on a mysterious island where every choice shapes your journey. Explore ancient ruins, gather resources, craft essential tools, battle dangerous wildlife, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within Eclipse Island in this immersive story-driven survival adventure.

title: Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm Demo
description: Experience the opening of Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm, a story-driven 2D retro JRPG. Explore Muja Village and Gaman Forest, complete quests, build your party and battle monsters in classic turn-based combat.

title: Deadlight Maze Demo
description: Deadlight Maze is a tense horror maze game where players must survive deadly traps and escape relentless zombies using strategy, flashlight colors, and quick decision-making. Navigate dangerous mazes, freeze zombies with matching light colors, and survive the darkness before the maze consumes you.

title: Compactor Baron Demo
description: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

title: Dungeons & Dynasties Demo
description: Football Manager meets D&D. Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.Lead an adventuring guild through a living realm where every fixture is a dungeon, every hero can die in it, and every season is written down.

title: 仅此一次的梦 - 未知玩家的岛屿冒险 Demo
developer: 时间不够了工作室, PixelateYiqi

title: CrystalCanvas Demo
description: The CrystalCanvas demo includes four Color by Number stages and unlimited access to Sandbox mode, where you can build whatever you like.Anything you build in Sandbox can be turned into a puzzle and played.Your creations and save data carry over to the full version.

title: sollervir Demo
description: Free demo of Sollervir, a loop-defense game of random summons and on-field unit fusion. Play chapters 1-3: grow nine basic units, master physical, magic, and pierce matchups, and battle through wild events. The full game adds 20 chapters, Endless Mode, and 171 achievements.

title: Last Wail of the Sea King Demo
Wirehawk Demo
description: Wirehawk is a retro boomer shmup: a top-down vertical bullet-heaven shooter in pure neon vector wireframe. Blast asteroids and alien waves, grab power-ups, dodge bullet storms and slow time with stasis - one ship, one laser, no mercy. Built for the mouse, gamepad supported. Autofire always on.

title: Deepvein Demo
description: Descend into a finite underground world, mine valuable ore, manage tool durability and backpack space, then climb back to the surface. Complete contracts, upgrade your gear, uncover crafting finds, map tunnels, and deploy field devices.

title: FIGHT Demo
description: Let's FIGHT. Queue your steps, guards, and strikes, then commit blind and watch both plans collide into skill based warfare. Master over twenty weapon-bound fighters, posture breaks, parries, projectiles with real time replays to watch the battle back in style.

title: Punctual Monsters Demo
description: A cute puzzle game about sleepy monsters and their alarm clocks. Every monster wakes up on its own number. Place your monsters and get everyone up on time.

title: Bearly Awesome: Chapter 1 Demo
description: Become a Bearlie and explore the colorful world of Snuzzleland! Solve puzzles, collect Honeycomb Coins, uncover hidden paths and belly-bump anything standing between you and your next adventure.

title: Mage Cat:Endless Breakout Survivor Demo
description: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign.

title: Devil's Sanctum Demo
description: Survive the Devil’s trials and earn your freedom in this top-down arena shooter. Cast into Hell as the Challenger, wade through relentless waves of demons and shape your build with powerful attunements.

title: Temple Of Your Mom Demo
description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime for the demo is 1 hour.

title: 日落萍江 Demo
description: A suspenseful visual novel set against the backdrop of the fictional Song Dynasty.

title: Reroll One Demo
description: A minimalist dice roguelite. Descend through six trials of chance and consequence. Luck isn’t random—it’s a mirror.

title: The Keyless: Forbidden Door Demo
description: Try the demo of The Keyless: Forbidden Door now, meet the green alien, escape from the entity and defeat the terrible rock monster!

title: March and Conquer Demo
description: The March and Conquer demo, is a short taste of the larger game. During the battle, use the skill tree to train units to fight against enemies on the battlefield. Gain gold and mana from wins and train different units and upgrade your army. March across multiple lands and fight fearsome foes!

title: The Offering Demo
description: Build a faith from borrowed bodies in this incremental shrine defence. Possess pilgrims, collect their offerings, and choose whether people, nature, or forgotten relics carry your religion. Grow the shrine by day, then defend it through the night with an ever-changing deck of boons.

title: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
description: Each word fuels the tower's assault. Catch the missing word from the audio, type it out, and a cannon blast strikes the lead enemy. The sharper your listening and the faster your fingers, the deadlier your firepower; hesitate for even a moment, and the horde pushes closer!

title: UNBIASED Demo
description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

title: The Killing Shift Demo
description: The Killing Shift is a survival horror sim where you work the night shift at a battery shipping company. Charge and ship batteries, complete your quotas, buy upgrades, and survive the dangers lurking inside the warehouse.

title: Pathos Demo
description: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.

title: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up Demo
description: Restore the Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 archaic books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Completing each run will unlock more powerful upgrades that will help you become the ultimate archivist.

title: Dead Spin Demo
description: Gamble your way through a deadly casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Survive the campaign or challenge other players in PvP mode. Discover broken synergies and keep spinning for your freedom!

title: Pig Up Demo
description: Pig Up is a third-person 3D platform adventure game. Control the piglet to climb floating platforms, travel through fantastic worlds to find lost companions and uncover the truth hidden behind the temporal chaos.

title: Armed-Mageddon Demo
description: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

title: Dao Without End Demo
description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

title: Strike Wings Demo
description: A free slice of Strike Wings: retro top-down space combat with Newtonian drift, subsystem damage and squadron AI. Fly the Reaper and the Talon through flight school, seven battles, a 1v1 duel and split-screen co-op.

title: 中国棋牌博物馆 Demo
description: Chinese Board Game Museum Demo includes six traditional Chinese card and Mahjong games: Dou Dizhu, Guan Dan, Paodekuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong, and Ka Wu Xing. Play offline against AI with authentic table rules and Chinese-inspired art. Online play will arrive in a later Demo update.

title: May, Be Dead Demo
description: May, Be Dead is a first-person surrealist adventure game about walking through endless hexagonal rooms of memory and repeatedly killing May, a mysterious figure you shared an intimate yet ambiguous relationship with.

title: Project R Tactical Demo
description: Build and customize an army of robots, equip them with a wide variety of weapons and gear, and complete tactical turn-based missions across different planets. Earn resources to upgrade your units, unlock new equipment, and adapt your strategy to overcome increasingly powerful enemy forces.

title: Magical Ascent Demo
description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

title: Necrocyte Demo
description: In a world devastated by the infected, you play as a surviving soldier enhanced with a mechanical arm. Explore dangerous regions, gather resources, discover powerful abilities, and fight to survive in a hostile world. The infected are everywhere — they will hunt you down without mercy.

title: Roadsters Odyssey Demo
description: Roadsters Odyssey is a Vehicular combat in development and playable right now. Race, fight, and survive against AI-driven war machines in free demo, with a minigun, missiles, and screen-clearing super weapons. Online multiplayer and fully destructible worlds are coming. Wishlist to follow the ride.

title: Bunker Siege Demo
description: A first-person wave-defense shooter. Hold one bunker as infantry, armour and aircraft come across the meadow through clear days, black nights and blinding fog. Work up from a revolver to a machine gun, hire riflemen for the wall, throw flares into the dark and call artillery. Money survives death.

title: Barkyard Blitz Demo
description: Every point has hooves—and every point can be stolen. Charge a weaponized bark, scatter rival flocks, and herd sheep home in chaotic third-person matches. Play Solo Practice or compete online with up to four human players in this free demo.

title: DREADSHELL Demo
description: DREADSHELL is a firstperson sci-fi psychological horror game set in an underground drilling facility. You are sent to investigate missing workers and continue the operation

title: Into The Lumberwoods Demo
description: An interdimensional rift just ruined Mothman's peaceful shack life! Into the Lumberwoods is a fast-paced top-down bullet hell roguelite about a very annoyed Mothman defending his woods using anything that isn't nailed down. Venture into the woods and blast weird monsters back to where they belong.

title: Radical Tower Defense
description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

title: Radia Island Demo
description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

title: Big Ballz Demo
description: Welcome to Big Ballz, where you control Big Ballz in a big world. Knock out the other Big Ballz and be the last Big Ball standing. Featuring Proximity Voice Chat and up to 10 players. Public and Private lobbies.

title: Me and You Demo
description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

title: Admirals of Ophiuchus Demo
description: Design massive ships, bristling with weapons, on a macro scale. Engage in fleet-vs-fleet battles, featuring many different tactics. Play alone or in Coop combat missions, or form two teams of players (each with own fleet) to fight in an arena.

title: ZoneZeroSurvivalDemo
description: Zero Zone Survival is a roguelike game that supports two-player co-op mode, allowing you to team up to challenge bosses in different levels. The game is thrilling and satisfying. We welcome you to try it out!

title: Necro Rising Demo
description: Command an undead legion in the free demo of Necro Rising. Drain souls, raise soldiers from corpses, and fight through the tutorial and the first level of Campaign Chapter 1. Tactical Trials and Endless Siege are not included.

title: Across the Dark Demo
description: Conquer Stage 1 & 2 in this official demo! Battle through a dark fantasy dungeon with 4 heroes—Bloodslayer, IronGuard, GrandMage, SwiftHealer—and 8-slot card synergies. No reflexes required; only your tactical deck building will save you. Wishlist the full game!

title: Heirs of the Moon Demo
description: Live, hunt, and lead as an apex predator embarked on a brutal survival adventure where every choice shapes your legacy. Find a mate, raise your pups, establish a pack and survive the dangers of the wild. Death is inevitable, but your journey continues with your bloodline.

title: Pokremental Demo
description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

title: Gateshock Demo
description: The complete GATESHOCK campaign, free: 16 missions across four planets, 14 unique towers, mid-mission tier upgrades, a deep meta skill tree, and the full map editor with shareable codes. Roguelite runs are reserved for the full game.

title: Renz Soccer Sim Demo
description: Build your squad, develop players, manage your club, and watch every match unfold in this 2D soccer management simulator. Chase trophies and build a dynasty.

title: 迷途梦境 Lost Dream Chronicle demo
description: "Lost Dream Chronicle" is a 3D action RPG that merges campus life simulation with 3D diorama-style Metroidvania, rooted in dream psychology. Nan, a young rookie chemistry teacher, finds herself trapped in a dangerous dream world. Fight through the dream, uncover secrets, and save the world!

title: No One Leaves the Starter Village Demo
Dice Tiny Town Demo
description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

title: Wordgeon Demo
description: 《Wordgeon》is a Balatro‑like deckbuilder where you fight using spelling and vocabulary. It turns the grind of learning vocabulary into a fun, strategic roguelike dungeon game.

title: 武道余晖 The Last Glimmer of the Martial Way Demo
description: In real-time action games controlled by mouse and keyboard, players defeat enemies to level up and learn skills, collect equipment to enhance their strength, and complete objectives within levels. After defeating all bosses, they can successfully save the world and complete the game.

title: Angel Offline Demo
description: A stranger texts your phone by mistake. You could ignore it, the way everyone ignores everything now. Instead, you answer. Angel Offline is a short visual novel about one accidental conversation that becomes something more, told entirely through the messages you choose to send.

title: Mother;Above Demo
description: Matoki is about to flood. The routes upward are sealed, and the official warnings conceal the danger. Step into the life of Vik, a drainage worker haunted by his mother's disappearance, in this demo of Mother;Above, a psychological horror VN about a city marked for sacrifice.

title: Oathbreak Dungeons Demo
description: In Oathbreak Dungeons, you descend—alone or with up to three friends, locally or online—into a procedural abyss that never repeats itself. In every room, reality-warping cards alter your capabilities. Survive the chaos. Or become part of it.

title: 猫猫爱钓鱼 Cat Fishing Demo
GLITCHVERSE Demo
description: GLITCHVERSE is a knowledge-lock Metroidvania puzzle game. You will explore this unknown and perilous world, acquire a variety of wondrous abilities, discover unexpected ways to use them, and ultimately unravel the secrets of this world.

title: Rush Your Band Demo
description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

title: Decadrive Demo
description: Free demo of Decadrive, a top-down arcade racer about endless traffic and a dying fuel gauge. Play Career phases 1-3 and Survival for up to five minutes. Wishlist the full game on Steam to keep driving.

title: Mine Liebe Musik 1 Demo
description: Cute little troublemakers put on elegant bullet-hell spectacles and trade some very inelegant insults in this weird, story-driven bullet-hell adventure. You're invited to a 30-minute prologue—the opening act of a strange and twisted tale.

title: Lead the Charge Demo
description: Lead Huo Qubing and a Han army into the Mobei steppe in a 20-minute army roguelite. Command charges, holds, volleys, and formation shifts, break encirclements, strengthen your host, and slay the enemy general.

title: Deaduction Demo
description: An otherworldly murder mystery blending horror, prop hunt, and supernatural powers. Work the night shift in a possessed hotel as an innocent staff member, a poltergeist controlling objects, or a body swapping doppelganger. Earn money to buy tools to uncover the imposters and survive the night shift.

title: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a Demo
OneMore Demo
description: OneMore is about language. It combines a traditional 'word making' game with knowledge of English.

title: Aeterna: Shattered Legacy Demo
description: A retro-style fantasy RPG where you explore towns and wilderness, complete quests, uncover secrets, and battle dangerous creatures while discovering the story of Aeterna.

title: Bird Game: Tokyo Demo
description: Bird Game: Tokyo is a fast-paced multiplayer flight game where you soar above sprawling cityscapes, weave between buildings, compete with other birds. Choose your bird, use its unique strengths, manage your energy, and outfly your opponents. Bird Game: Tokyo is a game about birds... in Tokyo.

title: STATO Demo
description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

title: Super Ragdoll Runner Ultimate Demo
description: A difficult active-ragdoll based platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and cool skips.

title: Bottlecappers Demo
description: All you have to do is make caps. Make them, and sell them. An honest job. Sure, there are the investors who believed in you. And every quarter they'll want to see the numbers. But really, your only task is to make caps. Almost.

title: Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade DEMO
Yuuki's Sky Demo
description: Yuuki's Sky: A modern urban BL story RPG. Navigate work, bonds and growth through your choices—find love, chase dreams and uncover yourself. Demo includes the first 15 days.

title: Ruptured Floor Demo
description: Dive into a surreal and dark office space made of distorted floors. Traverse them all, one at the time, to find an exit. Ruptured Floor is a horror puzzle game with a unique twist. Every floor requires a combination to open the door. The code is known. The lock, however, will need to be found.

title: Starless Umbra Demo
description: Starless Umbra is a story-rich action RPG inspired by the best of classic and modern JRPGs. Engage in real-time combat and explore puzzle-filled dungeons in a couch co-op adventure where friendship and loyalty are tested in a world consumed by a noxious fog.

title: NULL VECTOR Demo
description: NULL VECTOR is a top-down survival tower-defense game built from neon geometry. Protect the central core while directly controlling an operator unit: move, aim, fire, and deploy active skills as enemies close in from every direction.

title: Aeris Nexus Demo
description: Aeris Nexus is a modern airline management game where you build, expand, and optimize your own global carrier. Manage fleets, routes, staff, and finances as you compete for market dominance in a dynamic, ever‑changing aviation world.

title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator Demo
Neon Orbit Demo
description: Neon Orbit is a 360° radial gravity puzzle roguelite. Rotate planets, slot blocks falling toward the core, and draft card synergies to break the rules of the game. Face boss anomalies, survive system collapse, and conquer the Multiverse Rift.

title: Dead Grid Demo
description: Dead Grid is a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Experience tactical combat and cinematic 3D cutscenes. Play the first 3 missions for free, then continue your progress in the full game.

title: Burakku Jakku Samurai Demo
description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

title: Moto Courier Simulator Demo
description: Start with a beat-up bicycle and a pile of bills. Take courier jobs across a living island city, learn its traffic, haggle over second-hand motorcycles, and climb from delivery rider to shop owner. Ride out with up to four friends in online co-op.
developer: Mustafa Erdem Köşk, Ahmet Can Özen

title: Dyson Sphere: Desktop Factory Demo
description: Ignite your base on Tpler and forge your Dyson Sphere industrial wonder. Build automated desktop lines, deploy drone logistics, launch units to orbit. Draw tech perks for your build and boost output. Your custom Dyson Sphere orbit is exclusive live wallpaper, bringing cosmic romance to your desktop.

title: The Loomsong Chronicle Idle Demo
description: Lead a growing party through dangerous expeditions in this party-based idle RPG. Recruit, equip, train, gather, craft, and fight through level 25, then carry the same campaign into the full game without restarting.

title: The pilot always survives Demo
description: Control a helicopter, defend yourself from waves of enemies

title: 蛆之房 ~悬置之镜之歌~ Demo
description: Aliens turned humans into "maggots" – toiling underground, eating rotten flesh. Xingzhi has a house. Her and her tenants' fates are in your hands. Save Ku Yi? Follow Qi Qian? Each choice leads somewhere else. The road up is stained with blood. The answer is yours.

title: Slammer Soccer: Football Management Demo
description: Manage a prison football team, trade inmates, develop your squad, survive prison politics, and lead your team from the yard to glory.

title: Falafel Al Assad Demo
description: Do you have what it takes to serve the best Falafel in Moscow? Defy the elements in this whacky cooking sim and earn money to gain power-ups. Test your skills, and improve them to prepare for the final boss battle that will shake your world!

title: VICIOUS CIRCLE: The Way God Intended
description: Spiral into madness.

title: Zili Diary escape against witch Demo
description: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

title: Feastfall Demo
description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

title: Prism Panic Demo
description: This is a free demo — play the first 10 waves. A fast-paced arcade shooter where you blast through waves of baddies, collect power-ups, survive curses, and chase the high score. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

title: Drill Rover Demo
description: Drill Rover is an incremental game about mining walls in a foreign planet. Step on the gas, upgrade and go deep into the riches.

title: Void Ascend Demo
description: Push your limits in Void Ascend's physics-based, unforgiving climbing adventure! Grab ledges with precise timing, test your reflexes, and reach the peak in this relentless parkour where every mistake costs you dearly. Do you have the patience to reach the top?

title: Farm & Feast Demo
description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

title: Gas Station Simulator Demo
description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

title: Delivery Survivors Demo
description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

title: Heart Decay Demo
description: Heart Decay is a story-driven turn-based strategy game featuring 32-bit pixel art visuals. Execute lethal counter-attacks with precise timing during reaction windows that open during enemy moves. Shape your destiny in a dark world defined by a rich narrative.

title: Blotch Demo
description: Blotch is a stealth game about hiding from guards by painting yourself the exact color of the floor. Take the color under your feet, paint it over yourself, hold still, and let them walk right over the top of you. Thirty-two hand-made levels, plus online hide-and-seek.

title: Fishcremental Demo
description: Fishcremental is a ridiculously cozy underwater adventure where you catch super cute fish, discover game-changing upgrades, and fill the whole sea with satisfying firework glory.

title: CyberRushUasSimulator Demo
description: 专业的无人机仿真模拟训练软件，为新手与进阶飞手提供安全、高效的训练平台。软件内置标准化科目考核体系，覆盖基础操作，训练场景；同时提供多套丰富逼真的训练环境，全方位还原真实飞行体验。软件支持键盘、手柄等多种操作方式，无需实体无人机即可完成从入门到精通的全流程训练，大幅降低学习成本与安全风险。

title: Sideways Motorways Demo
description: Turns and corners? No thank you! In this traffic-simulation game all roads are straight and cars never brake. A smart city planner like you would do the sensible thing and move the houses around instead, to avoid intersections. Or would you rather take the thrill of a close call for a higher score?

title: Ectorider Demo
description: Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ecto's evil plan.

title: Helion Conflict Demo
description: The free demo of Helion Conflict - and during Steam Next Fest it's the full game, with nothing locked. Capture shipyards, split fleets by exact percentage, turn them in mid-flight. Up to eight online. Minutes, not hours.

title: LumberBoy Demo
description: A woodcutting incremental where you explore different forests, process wood, and keep growing. Start with just a basic axe, max out your stats, and become the greatest lumberjack in the forest!

title: Oneiric Voyage Demo
description: [Oneiric Voyage] is a creature-collecting adventure game with single and multiplayer.Explore alone or team up with global players to catch and bond with 123 unique spirits.Enjoy our special fun mode for a brand-new experience.

title: NodeFeat Demo
description: Still reading? No time to talk. TO THE FRONT. A phosphorescent swarm is devouring everything in its path and Node 52 is next. Your base is a tree: grow it, turn it, dig in, HOLD. A million, a billion, who cares. Kill them all.

title: 起業×経営体験ゲーム『おいでよ！スタートアップ村』 Demo
description: This is a free demo version of the full game. In the demo, you can play from the startup phase through Turn 10 of the management phase. Oideyo Startup Mura is a simulation game that lets you experience the challenges and excitement of starting and running your own business.

title: SoundRoom Demo
description: Guess the type of instrument being played.

title: Misery Dungeon Demo
description: This is the demo version of Misery Dungeon. It's a standalone part of the experience, completely spoiler free. Get a free glimpse of the horrors contained in the Ktol'maa Mountain.

title: MORROWTAPE Demo
description: A first-person psychological horror game set beneath a condemned 1989 telephone archive. Tune impossible calls, evade a creature that hunts every sound you make, and decide which evidence the city is allowed to remember.

title: Boarding House: Night Shift Demo
description: Boarding House: Night Shift — Welcome to the Night ShiftWelcome to your new job. Be careful... because your first night might be your last.We are proud to introduce Boarding House: Night Shift, a survival horror experience that takes you into a remote boarding house hidden deep in the mountains, where a simple night job slowly turns into...

title: Orca Gril: Idle Fishing Story Demo
description: Fish, farm, and build your island alongside adorable Orca Girls! A cozy idle game that runs at the bottom or in any corner of your screen while you work or study. Collect rare and exotic fish, then create and decorate your own fantasy pixel-art aquariums.

title: Carnival Stand Simulator Demo
description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the carnival.

title: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey Demo
description: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

title: 三天 Demo
description: 由真实经历改编的叙事视觉小说。宝宝出生前三天，一位新手爸爸在产房外学着成为父亲。日常之下，每一个选择都在改写他与妻子、家人之间的关系。完整版单次流程约一小时（DEMO仅包含序章内容）。

title: Duck Fest Demo
description: Try Duck Fest: classic playing cards meet strategic 1v1 battles! Use card effects and well-timed passes to claim the flag. Enjoy the story’s opening and online friend matches. Steam Community Market card trading is exclusive to the full game.

title: SCOP Demo
description: A roguelite twist on classic Italian Scopa. Build powerful combinations with Relics and Marks, visit Shops, defeat escalating Blind and Boss encounters, and experience the first three RUNS before continuing your journey in the full game.

title: Kyoumei Demo
description: Fight alongside Kannagi Mashiro, your childhood friend and a mysterious shrine maiden from a parallel world, to save your world in this 2D anime action game with visual novel storytelling.

title: Audionaut Demo
description: This demo is a small, playable version of Audionaut, a 2D music composition spaceship autobattler.

title: Clicker Inc.～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～ Demo
description: 代替わりで強くなる経営クリッカーゲーム！最初はクリックでコツコツ稼ぎ、社員を雇って自動で収益が上がる不労所得システムを構築。株、銀行、オークションを活用して、バブル到来と崩壊の波を乗りこなそう。社長の寿命が来たら世代交代（転生）のとき！100以上のスキルで次世代を強化し、さらに稼げる体制へ。大量の実績コンプリートや歴代社長の歩みを振り返る年譜機能も満載。小さな一打を皮切りに、何代にもわたって経営のバトンを繋ぎ、世界を動かす巨大企業を作り上げよう！ ※本ゲームは『Clicker Inc. ～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～』の体験版です。4回目の転生までがプレイできます。

title: 弾幕乱舞 ― バレットバラージュ ― Demo
Age of Sail Demo
description: Age of Sail is a boat combat game that revolves around killing pirates (or other players.)  You can upgrade your cannons to have up to 5 on each side.  You can sell loot to replenish health and ammo.

title: Penguin Weapons Demo
description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

title: Mega Sokofox World Demo
description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

title: Find The Needle Demo
description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

title: Grimhold Demo
description: Demo of Grimhold, a dark-fantasy tower defense roguelike: play the entire first act and command three unique heroes. Hold the wall, reshape every run, and wishlist the full game.

title: Ordinary People Demo
description: Ordinary People is a game about building a cozy little town at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work or study.  As you build your town, Ordinary People will begin to move in, interacting with one another in some not-so-Ordinary ways.

title: SlapBox: Audio Tools Demo
description: SlapBox: Audio Tools Demo lets you import and record audio, use the waveform editor, preview effects in real time, and explore the core SlapBox workflow.Demo limitations: Audio export, keyframing, and saving or loading .slap project files are available in the full version only.

title: Fireworks Incremental Demo
description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

title: GEOMETRY NEXUS Demo
description: Geometry Nexus is a neon action roguelike where your weapons fire automatically. Dodge enemy swarms, collect upgrades, trigger Overdrive, grow stronger between runs, and survive ten minutes to defeat the Nexus Guardian.

title: Zœufs Story Academie Demo
description: Raise a Zanmi egg at the "Academie des Zœufs". Care for it, choose its activities and training, and build relationships with the other students to shape its growth in this character-raising simulation. What kind of Zanmi will you raise?

title: Tile Blast - Puzzle Game Demo
description: Tile Blast Demo lets you experience the addictive Classic Mode for free. Place blocks, clear lines, chase high scores, and get a taste of the full Tile Blast experience, featuring Time Mode, Duel Mode, skins, cases, and more.

title: Cité Alexandrie Demo
developer: Sirène Rouge Games, La Belle Games

title: Starfinder: Afterlight Demo
description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

title: Gun a Rat Demo
description: Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends? Then this game is made for you! Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!

title: Black Ball Demo
description: It's normal for this game to have bugs because it's outdated. The demo only has 30 levels, and more will be announced.

title: Black Hole Surfers Demo
description: Trapped after being sucked into a black hole, your only hope is to gather resources from the passing debris, upgrade your ship and survive long enough to find a way to escape. A unique blend of bullet-heaven action and incremental upgrading, will you find your way back home in Black Hole Surfers?

title: Gunship Incremental Demo
description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

title: IT MOVES! - Build Your Own Robot Demo
description: LIMITED-CONTENT DEMO: Play the four opening contracts of IT MOVES! Time a piston, choose the right drive for heavy loads, coordinate a gate and stamp, and assemble your first wheeled robot.

title: Mimic in the Dungeon Demo
description: You are the Tentacle Mimic! Build your dungeon and lure female adventurers inside. Recruit them for your harem to harness their energy and grow stronger.

title: Froggous Grove Demo
description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

title: Bob BOBBED Bob... Demo
developer: Adam and Simmons (Isaac Ward & Julian Ward)

title: Delenar TD: Remastered Demo
description: Delenar TD Remastered is an old school Grid based Tower Defense game, where you control the path of the mobs. Build towers, place mazing rocks, and adapt to the mobs in each level. The strategy of solving each level is completely up to you!

title: Twilight Gallery Demo
